name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: After sea giants strike his ship in Desolace, Karnitol flees with his servants by teleporting away. Kreldig Ungor sends you to find the noble's chest.

sections.title: A Noble's Flight
sections.body:
After Reclaimers' Business in Desolace, Kreldig Ungor sends you to find Karnitol's lost chest. Karnitol is a mage and some kind of noble in Stormwind. Sea giants struck his ship in the northwest waters of Desolace.

He and his servants tried to bring one of his costlier chests ashore, but the giants swarmed them. Karnitol left the chest behind and teleported away with his servants. Find the chest and its contents, then return them to Karnitol in Stormwind. It lies along the northern coastline, in the Ethel Rethor stretch.

sections.title: What the Chest Shows
sections.body: Karnitol's chest has no water damage, but someone forced its lid open. Burn marks around the edges show that its magical traps were sprung long ago.

faq.answer: Karnitol is a mage and some kind of noble in Stormwind. Sea giants struck his ship in Desolace's northwest waters.

Sea giants struck Karnitol's ship in Desolace's northwest waters. Karnitol and his servants tried to bring a valuable chest ashore, but the giants swarmed them. He left it behind and teleported away with his servants.

faq.q: Who is looking for the chest?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor is looking for the chest. He says Karnitol wants it and its contents found and returned to him in Stormwind.
The chest lies along Desolace's northern coastline, in the Ethel Rethor stretch.
